decisions.title: Adopt the personal workflow guide 1.2 for Fruit Market
decisions.question: Should Fruit Market be run with the workflow guide (one approved package at a time, evidence-based checks, decision records)?
decisions.choice: Yes; one package at a time, starting with Package A.
decisions.rationale: The game is complete but releases were unreviewed and records lived in chat history.

impact.technical: Adds checks, records and a release gate.

decisions.reviewTrigger: If the process costs more time than it saves after three packages.

decisions.title: Package A scope = PLAN-001
decisions.question: What should the first setup package contain?
decisions.choice: One verify command, preview before publishing, short records and an owner brief (PLAN-001).
decisions.rationale: Smallest package that stops unreviewed releases and gives the owner a clear way to try builds.

impact.player: None until a release; protects players from silent breakage.
impact.technical: package.json scripts, CI and deploy workflows, new docs.

approval.evidence: Approve PLAN-001 only, including its listed tests and documentation

decisions.reviewTrigger: Acceptance A4 (owner preview playtest) still pending.

decisions.title: Live deploys only through the manual Deploy workflow after verify
decisions.question: When should the live game change?
decisions.choice: Only when the owner runs Deploy LIVE game and types PUBLISH; it runs verify first and a smoke test after. Never on push.
decisions.rationale: Makes 'a preview is not a release' true for this repository.

impact.player: Updates arrive only after the owner approves them.

decisions.cost: RM0; one extra tap per release.

approval.evidence: Approve PLAN-001 only, including its listed tests and documentation

decisions.reviewTrigger: If urgent fixes are delayed because nobody pressed Deploy.

decisions.title: PDF exports with pandoc and the existing Playwright browser
decisions.question: Which tool builds the decision PDFs?
decisions.choice: pandoc (Markdown to HTML) plus the project's existing Playwright Chromium (HTML to PDF). No installs.
decisions.rationale: Both are already available; no new dependency.

impact.technical: PDF export runs locally, not in CI.

decisions.reviewTrigger: If pandoc is unavailable on the machine that exports.

decisions.title: Budget interpretation: RM500 per month across all games
decisions.question: How should the RM500 monthly ceiling be applied?
decisions.choice: Treat it as portfolio-wide. Fruit Market's current spend is unknown (hypothesis: Cloudflare Free, or Workers Paid at about USD 5).

impact.technical: Paid services need a quote and approval.

decisions.reviewTrigger: When the owner states the Cloudflare plan and other paid accounts.

decisions.title: Preview = separate staging Worker
decisions.question: How should changes be previewed, given that Cloudflare preview and version URLs are not generated for Workers with Durable Objects?
decisions.choice: A separate Worker, fruit-market-staging, with its own rooms, leaderboard and stats, updated by CI after checks pass on main.
decisions.rationale: Closest free option to a per-change preview URL; keeps the live data untouched.

impact.player: None; players never see the preview.
impact.technical: A second Worker and a preview job in CI.
impact.data: Separate storage; preview link is unlisted, not private.

decisions.cost: No new paid service; tiny usage within the existing plan.
decisions.reviewTrigger: If Cloudflare adds preview URLs for Durable Object Workers.

decisions.title: Package B scope = PLAN-002
decisions.question: What should the records package contain?
decisions.choice: Canonical JSON records, generated views (register, changelog, state block, PDFs), a records check in verify, release tagging on Deploy, and migration of existing records.
decisions.rationale: Records were kept by hand in several places with nothing checking that they agreed.

impact.technical: New records, a generator and checker script, and a deploy step.

approval.evidence: Approve PLAN-002 only, including its listed tests and documentation

decisions.reviewTrigger: If keeping records costs more than it saves.

decisions.title: Canonical record format: JSON records plus Markdown narrative reports
decisions.question: Where is the single source of truth for decisions and packages?
decisions.choice: JSON files in docs/workflow/records; hand-written REP reports stay as narrative snapshots; Markdown, changelog and PDF views are generated.
decisions.rationale: Node reads JSON without dependencies and the check can be strict. YAML needs a parser; plain Markdown can't be validated; a database is ruled out by the guide.

impact.technical: Claude edits the JSON; the owner reads the generated views.

approval.evidence: Approve PLAN-002 only, including its listed tests and documentation

decisions.reviewTrigger: If hand edits to JSON become a frequent source of errors.

decisions.title: Records check runs in verify and CI
decisions.question: Should record disagreements fail the build?
decisions.choice: Yes: npm run verify runs records:check, so CI fails on broken records.
decisions.rationale: Once branch protection is on, broken records can't be merged.

approval.evidence: Approve PLAN-002 only, including its listed tests and documentation

decisions.reviewTrigger: If the check blocks urgent fixes for record reasons.

decisions.title: Reconnect fix scope = PLAN-004 (evidence first, then fix)
decisions.question: How should the intermittent rejoin failure be fixed?
decisions.choice: Collect evidence and reproduce it with a stress test before changing game code; fix only the measured root cause, with a regression test.
decisions.rationale: Reading the code didn't identify a certain cause, and two failures in five runs are too rare to debug by guessing. The workflow guide says to reproduce and isolate before fixing.

impact.player: Fewer stuck screens after a reload or dropped connection, once the fix is published.
impact.technical: New stress test and diagnostics; a small fix in the online client or room server.
impact.data: Diagnostics stay in CI artifacts for 7 days; they contain test players only.

decisions.cost: RM0 (GitHub Actions minutes are free for public repositories)

approval.evidence: Approve PLAN-004 only, including its listed tests and documentation

decisions.reviewTrigger: If not reproduced after 300 cycles: stop and report.

decisions.title: Stress test runs on demand, not on every push
decisions.question: Should the long reconnect stress test run in every CI run?
decisions.choice: No: a manual CI workflow plus local runs. Every-push CI keeps the existing tests (about 15 minutes).
decisions.rationale: Hundreds of cycles would make every CI run far slower; the stress test is for investigation and before releases.

approval.evidence: Approve PLAN-004 only, including its listed tests and documentation

decisions.reviewTrigger: If reconnect bugs slip through between releases.

decisions.title: 4-player clarity scope = PLAN-005 (screen text only)
decisions.question: How should the game make 4-player play discoverable?
decisions.choice: Clearer screen text and open-seat rows in the lobby, short hints on the home, quick-match and new-game screens, plus an automated 4-person test. No rule or server changes.
decisions.rationale: 4-player play already works; only discoverability is missing. Text changes are low risk and fast to verify.

impact.player: Groups of 3 or 4 can find how to play together.
impact.technical: src/ui/Online.tsx, src/ui/App.tsx, styles; one new browser test.

decisions.reviewTrigger: If playtesters still miss how to invite more than one friend.
